phrases.text: The wheel turns whether you act or not. Step gently into the current.
You do not begin the game. The game begins through you.
Cross {from} → {to} (Δ {dif}). The board shifts, but the witness remains.
{evento}. Every action echoes beyond the square you see.
{evento}. When alignment is true, movement requires no force.
Cross {from} → {to} (Δ {dif}). Distance is illusion; awareness is the real step.
What resists returns. What is understood dissolves.
Advance without grasping. The center does not move.
The dice fall in matter. The meaning falls in consciousness.
Nirvana is not ahead of you. It is behind the illusion of ahead.
